잘 먹겠습니다.forms: polite: 잘 먹을게요 · casual: 잘 먹을게
잘 먹겠습니다.m: thank you for the meal (said before eating)
잘 먹겠습니다.x: Wow, it looks delicious! Thank you for the meal.
잘 먹겠습니다.e: Literally 'I will eat well' — said before eating, to whoever cooked or is paying.

몸.e: 몸살 = achy, run-down feeling from fatigue — a very common complaint.
몸.t: 몸이 안 좋아요 = I'm not feeling well. 몸조심하세요 = Take care of yourself.

테니스.x: I play tennis with my older sister every Saturday.
테니스.t: Racket and hitting sports use 치다: 테니스를 치다, 탁구를 치다, 골프를 치다.

말리다.ex: 우리 집은 빨래를 보통 베란다에서 말려요.
말리다.x: At our house, we usually dry the laundry on the balcony.
말리다.e: Causative of 마르다 'to become dry'. Homonym: 말리다 also means 'to stop someone'.
말리다.t: For hair, say 머리를 말리다 = to dry your hair.

피하다.m: to avoid, to dodge, to take shelter from
피하다.ex: 갑자기 비가 와서 편의점 안에서 비를 피했어요.
피하다.x: It suddenly rained, so I took shelter in a convenience store.

행동.x: Actions are much more important than words.

비우다.m: to empty, to clear; to leave (a place) vacant
비우다.ex: 이사하기 전에 방을 모두 비워야 해요.
비우다.x: I have to clear out the whole room before moving.
비우다.e: Causative of 비다 'to be empty': to make something empty.
rel: to step away from one's seat

채우다.m: to fill, to fill up; to make up (a shortfall)
채우다.x: I filled the cup all the way with water.
채우다.e: Causative of 차다 'to be full': literally 'make it full'.
채우다.t: Its opposite is 비우다 'to empty': 잔을 비우다 'to empty one's glass'.

협상.ex: 두 회사는 오랜 협상 끝에 계약을 맺었어요.
협상.x: After long negotiations, the two companies signed a contract.
협상.t: Pronounced [협쌍] — ㅅ after ㅂ becomes tense.

준비물.ex: 내일 미술 시간 준비물은 가위와 풀이에요.
준비물.x: The supplies for tomorrow's art class are scissors and glue.
준비물.e: Literally 'prepared things': what you need to bring.
준비물.t: A classic school word: teachers announce tomorrow's 준비물 at the end of class.

골고루.forms: 골고루 + verb: 골고루 먹어요, 골고루 나눠요
골고루.m: evenly, equally; a little of everything
골고루.ex: 건강을 위해서 음식을 골고루 먹어야 해요.
골고루.x: For your health, you should eat a balanced variety of food.
골고루.e: An emphatic, rhyming form of 고루 'evenly'.
골고루.t: 골고루 먹다 is the standard way to say 'eat a balanced diet' — parents say it to picky kids.

버티다.x: I have to get by on the money I have left until payday.

알아차리다.ex: 엄마는 제 기분이 안 좋은 것을 바로 알아차렸어요.
알아차리다.x: My mom noticed right away that I was in a bad mood.

그러게.forms: casual reply · polite: 그러게요 · 그러게 말이야 (strong agreement)
그러게.m: I know, right; tell me about it; yeah (casual agreement)
그러게.x: I know, right? It's really hot today.
그러게.e: From 그렇다 'to be so' + -게, used as a reply: 'it is so, indeed'.
그러게.t: Casual 반말 for friends; add 요 to be polite. In another tone, 그러게 내가 뭐랬어 means 'See, what did I tell you?'

발전기.ex: 정전이 되자 병원에서 바로 발전기를 돌렸어요.
발전기.x: When the power went out, the hospital started its generator right away.
발전기.t: Don't confuse 발전 'power generation' with 발전 'development', as in 경제 발전.

풍력.ex: 바람이 많이 부는 제주도에는 풍력 발전기가 많아요.
풍력.x: Windy Jeju Island has a lot of wind turbines.
풍력.t: Pronounced [풍녁]: ㄹ becomes ㄴ after the ㅇ batchim.

연달아.forms: 연달아 + verb/count: 연달아 세 번 이기다
연달아.m: in a row, consecutively, one after another
연달아.ex: 우리 팀이 연달아 세 경기를 이겼어요.
연달아.x: Our team won three games in a row.
연달아.e: From 연달다 'to follow in succession'; 연 means connect.

오로지.ex: 그는 오로지 가족을 위해 열심히 일했어요.
오로지.x: He worked hard solely for his family.

겸.forms: Noun 겸 noun · verb-(으)ㄹ 겸 verb-(으)ㄹ 겸
겸.m: and also, cum (combining two roles or purposes)
겸.ex: 운동도 할 겸 바람도 쐴 겸 공원에 갔어요.
겸.x: I went to the park both to exercise and to get some fresh air.
겸.e: Literally 'combining'; 거실 겸 서재 means 'living room cum study'.

동문서답.ex: 질문을 했는데 그 사람은 계속 동문서답만 했어요.
동문서답.x: I asked a question, but he kept giving answers that had nothing to do with it.
동문서답.e: Literally 'asked about east, answered about west'.

신분제.ex: 조선은 양반과 노비가 있는 엄격한 신분제 사회였습니다.
신분제.x: Joseon was a society with a strict class system of yangban and slaves.

연구진.x: A Korean research team developed a new treatment.

혹평.ex: 그 영화는 개봉 후 평론가들의 혹평을 받았어요.
혹평.x: After its release, that film was panned by critics.
혹평.t: Don't mix up 호평 (good) and 혹평 (harsh); the extra ㄱ makes it the cruel one.

육박하다.m: to approach, to come close to (a number); to close in on
육박하다.ex: 관객 수가 천만 명에 육박하고 있습니다.
육박하다.x: The number of moviegoers is approaching ten million.
육박하다.e: Literally 'to close in body to body', as in hand-to-hand fighting.
육박하다.t: Used with 에 for figures: 100%에 육박하다 = to near 100 percent.

통합되다.m: to be integrated, to be merged, to be unified
통합되다.x: The two companies were merged into one.

이구동성.x: The students all said with one voice that the test was hard.

속력.ex: 자동차가 고속도로에 들어서자 갑자기 속력을 높였어요.
속력.x: As soon as the car got on the highway, it suddenly sped up.

소비 심리.ex: 물가가 오르면서 소비 심리가 크게 위축됐습니다.
소비 심리.x: As prices rose, consumer sentiment shrank sharply.
소비 심리.e: Literally 'consumption psychology': how willing people feel to spend.
소비 심리.t: Pronounced [소비 심니] — nasalization of ㄹ after ㅁ.

전세권.m: jeonse right (registered right of a lump-sum deposit tenant)
전세권.ex: 세입자는 보증금을 지키기 위해 전세권을 등기했습니다.
전세권.x: The tenant registered a jeonse right to protect the deposit.
전세권.e: 전세 is Korea's lump-sum deposit lease: no monthly rent, deposit returned at the end.

복역.x: He was released after serving five years in prison.
복역.t: Pronounced [보격]: the batchim ㄱ links to the next vowel.

인수합병.ex: 두 회사는 인수합병을 통해 하나의 회사가 되었습니다.
인수합병.x: The two firms became one company through a merger.
인수합병.e: 인수 'takeover' + 합병 'merger' — the Korean term for M&A.
인수합병.t: Korean news also just says M&A, read 엠앤에이.

선언문.ex: 회의가 끝난 뒤 참가국들은 선언문을 채택했어요.
선언문.x: After the conference, the participating countries adopted a declaration.

고조선.ex: 고조선은 단군왕검이 세운 한국 최초의 국가예요.
고조선.x: Gojoseon is Korea's first state, founded by Dangun Wanggeom.
고조선.e: 'Old' was added by later historians to tell it apart from the Joseon dynasty (1392–1910).

단도직입.ex: 단도직입적으로 말할게요. 그 계획은 안 돼요.
단도직입.x: I'll be blunt: that plan won't work.
단도직입.e: Literally 'charging straight in with a single sword'.
단도직입.t: Most common as 단도직입적으로 묻다/말하다 'to ask/say directly'.

상통하다.m: to have in common, to be in line with; to communicate mutually
상통하다.ex: 두 사람의 생각은 여러 면에서 상통해요.
상통하다.x: The two of them think alike in many ways.

숙청하다.x: The dictator brutally purged the opposition.
숙청하다.e: Literally 'sternly cleanse': removing rivals from power.

역기능.x: The internet has both positive and negative effects.
역기능.t: Usually paired: 순기능과 역기능 'the pros and cons, the good and bad effects'.
